summary: CPU re-embed measured 8.5 rows/s (fp32, bge-base-en-v1.5, 16 vCPU) -> 29.1M rows = 39.7 days / ~. Pipeline fully works (download, smoke, commit, resume) but throughput is infeasible at this scale.
root_cause: CPU fp32 inference for bge-base-en-v1.5 is ~8.5 rows/s on a c6i.4xlarge. The 29.1M-row re-embed needs GPU-class throughput (T4 = 13-27h). GPU quota (L-DB2E81BA) was rejected by AWS; the  credits cover CPU cost but not the 40-day timeline.
